text.content:
Running Arasaka for more than a century.

Role: CEO of Arasaka
Affiliation: Arasaka
Known for: Leading the company since 1960

He took over Arasaka in 1960 and still runs it more than a hundred years later, which says everything about the company's power. His granddaughter Michiko, Kei Arasaka's only daughter, came home to the family in 2070 and serves as its Accord Liaison in Night City.

Edgerunner's Handbook p.23; Night City 2070 (The Unification Era), ch.05
